_comment: The gold-standard evaluation set. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: scripts/evaluate_*.py and tests/test_retrieval.py read this file via src/core/gold.py, and tests/test_gold_set.py fails if the human-readable tables in data/README.md drift from it. Edit both together. Rows T1-T13 were written against the synthetic Ch6 starter corpus, T14-T25 against the downloaded study materials (data/SOURCES.md); every row was written before it was measured.
